breakdown.description: Normal shock waves only form in supersonic flow
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the upstream Mach number of 0.8 (subsonic), whereas the ground truth corrects it to M = 2.0 (supersonic). Normal shock waves only form in supersonic flow, and the agent did not fix this error.

breakdown.description: Second law of thermodynamics prohibits expansion shocks (subsonic to supersonic transitions via shock)
breakdown.reason: The generated specification proceeds with M = 0.8 without acknowledging that applying normal shock relations to subsonic flow would imply an expansion shock, violating the second law of thermodynamics. The ground truth resolves this by using M = 2.0. The agent did not address this inconsistency.
